name: touch-s2n-naming-confirm
description: #289 acceptance, generated by runner/test/unit/naming-scenarios.js. Boots from touch-md1-1 (kept by touch-playthrough). Input: wait 30 frames; route to md1_1's gateway 1 (md1_2), at most 9000 frames, driving scenes (#293): Interact through every waiting message window and, on the naming screen (gameState 5 with fieldEventCmd 6), semantic/controls.js NAMING_ACTIONS.useDefault (start, then circle; each group held 4 frames, one every 30). End checks: md1_2 (0x76), field mode, and fieldEventCmd no longer 6. Metrics: out_g (route outcome: 1 reached, 2 stuck, 3 timeout, 4 left field mode, 5 no walkmesh, 6 no goal, 7 no path), named (route frame + 1 when the naming screen was first seen, 0 never), nleft (frames on the naming screen until field mode came back, 0 never), smode (first other gameState seen in a scene drive), evt (fieldEventCmd then), and the three end checks (1 holds, 0 not). Only those numbers leave.
